About this item

  • 【Height Adjustable Desk Lamp for Office home】The Height Adjustable LED Desk Lamp features a dual-head design with an extension range from 15.55 to 22.83 inches. Its swivel arms provide 180-degree lateral rotation and 90-degree vertical tilt adjustment. The flexible dual swing arms enable precise light direction control, delivering expanded coverage for optimal visibility.
  • 【Eye-caring LED Desk Lamps】This desk lamp features 76 energy-saving lamp beads with a CRI (Ra) >80%, delivering uniform, soft, flicker-free, glare-free, and shadow-free illumination that effectively relieves eye fatigue and provides optimal eye protection. The touch-sensitive control eliminates complicated buttons, ensuring simple and intuitive operation. Please Note: If the bulb and USB charging work at the same time, please use a 5V/3A or better adapter to avoid problems such as light flickering.
  • 【Stepless Dimming】 This desk lamp featuring 10 brightness levels and 5 color temperatures (3000K-6500K), offering 50 different lighting modes! Our desk lamp allows you to adjust the lighting according to your environment to meet your needs.
  • 【Space Saving Design Desk Lamp】This foldable desk lamp is a space-saver's dream! Its innovative folding mechanism allows you to effortlessly collapse it down when not in use, freeing up valuable space on your desk, shelf, or nightstand. Need to move it? No problem! Lightweight yet durable, it easily transitions from your home office to your bedside table. Perfect for dorm rooms, small apartments, or any area where maximizing space is key.
  • 【Auto-Off Timer 】45-minute automatic shutdown timer to help you sleep soundly, without worrying about falling asleep while reading a book at night. Worry-free purchase, our office desk lamp comes with a 24-month warranty.

From the brand

  2. Light is the ritual of focus

    CHARYJOD desk lamp was born from its founder James’s personal struggle.

    A decade ago, founder James hunched over his MBA prep under a cheap desk lamp’s harsh glare. The stinging light burned his eyes, while the cold metal base mirrored his solitude. In that moment, clarity struck: light should never be torment—it must be a sanctuary for thought.

  11. How did we get started?

    The pain that began with the founder: the headache and loneliness caused by inferior desk lamps during MBA preparation, drives us to redefine the relationship between light and people.

    Why do we love what we do?

    When we receive an email from a user saying,

    "My child is studying under your lamp and getting into medical school,"

    or "This beam of light accompanies me to sign the first round of financing,"

    what we see is not the lamps, but the silent witnesses spectators of important moments in life.

    Product Description

    The CHARYJOD Dimmable LED Desk Lamp is a versatile lighting solution for your home, office, or dorm room. With its dual swing arm design, this lamp provides a larger lighting area, allowing you to illuminate your workspace efficiently. Desk lamp boasting 50 lighting modes and 10 brightness levels, you can easily adjust the light intensity and color temperature to suit your preferences. The desk light also features a USB charging port, making it convenient to charge your devices while you work. The sensitive touch control and auto-off timer ensure effortless operation and energy-saving. Crafted with an eye-caring LED, this desk lamp offers a comfortable lighting experience, reducing eye strain during long hours of use.
